blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to the airport.

On the way, you will see Avenida 9 de Julio and the Obelisk once more and, depending on the transfer route, Puerto Madero with its brick docks, towers and waterfronts.

Fly to Santiago. On arrival, you will be met and transferred to your hotel.

Santiago has a more restrained feel than Rio and Buenos Aires. On a clear day, the Andes are visible above the city. The rest of the day is free.
